Quaternius P0 Prop Kit Subset

Selected source assets copied from:
- Quaternius Fantasy Props MegaKit, Standard version
  https://quaternius.com/packs/fantasypropsmegakit.html
  https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-props-megakit
- Quaternius Medieval Village MegaKit, Standard version
  https://quaternius.com/packs/medievalvillagemegakit.html
  https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-village-megakit

License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0).
Author: Quaternius.

Only a small FBX subset was imported for the unattended P0-8 review pass:
barrel, crate, farm crate, market stall/cart, bench, chest, and wooden/metal fence pieces.
Imported source PBR/materials are not used by the scene. The Unity prefabs created by
AnemoraFastVsHouseSliceSetup assign the local FastVS toon/ramp surface material instead.
